headline: Attacks Hit Two Saudi Airports as Yemen Fighting Escalates
seoTitle: Attacks Hit Two Saudi Airports, Injuring Three
seoDescription: Saudi aviation authorities said attacks damaged Jazan and Najran airports and lightly injured three people amid renewed fighting with Yemen's Houthis.
deck: Saudi authorities confirmed damage and three minor injuries; they did not publicly identify the attacker in the aviation statement.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Attacks struck King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Jazan and Najran International Airport on the evening of October 5, damaging both facilities and lightly injuring three people, Saudi Arabia's General Authority of Civil Aviation said on October 6.

The aviation statement did not identify who carried out the attacks. The incidents followed a Houthi announcement that the group had fired missiles and drones toward Saudi Arabia. The Associated Press said it could not independently confirm a separate Houthi claim involving Abha International Airport.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The airport attacks came as Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces fought Houthi forces around Dhubab and near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. That waterway connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and is important to global trade and energy shipments.

The developments are a continuation of the renewed Saudi-Houthi conflict. FMB News' earliest report on the current cross-border escalation is available at https://www.francinemariebautista.com/news/houthi-attacks-saudi-cities-energy-september-8-2026/.

sections.heading: Confirmed and unresolved
paragraphs: Confirmed by Saudi aviation authorities are the two airport strikes, property damage and three minor injuries. Responsibility for those specific impacts was not assigned in the official civil-aviation statement, and the claimed Abha strike remained unconfirmed when checked.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Further escalation near major airports and the Bab el-Mandeb shipping route can affect regional travel, overseas Filipino workers, commercial shipping and oil prices.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch airport operating notices, any official attribution, further cross-border strikes, fighting near Bab el-Mandeb and effects on shipping, oil markets and Filipino workers or travelers in the region.
